user.title: Add a plant
user.description:
Type any plant name - if it matches our built-in list, thresholds and a care tip are pre-filled on the next steps (still fully editable). Optionally pick the device your sensor belongs to (e.g. a Zigbee2MQTT plant sensor) and its entities will be auto-mapped.

Tip: a dashboard card (`plant-monitor-card`) ships with this integration. It's usually made available automatically; if not, add the resource `/plant_monitor_files/plant-monitor-card.js` yourself once via Settings -> Dashboards -> ⋮ -> Resources.

data.name: Plant name (your own label for it)

entities.title: Sensor entities
entities.description: Pre-filled from the device you picked, if any. Adjust anything that's wrong.

care.title: Thresholds & care tip
care.description: Pre-filled if your plant matched our species list - edit anything you like.

photo.title: Photo (optional)
photo.description: Drag and drop a photo of your plant, or skip this - you can add one later from the plant's device page.

notifications.title: Notifications (optional)
notifications.description: Get a push notification when this plant needs water or has been overwatered, and/or a daily status summary. Pick the device the notification should go to (e.g. your phone's mobile app) and flip the toggles on - both are off by default. You can change this any time from the plant's Configure menu.

advanced.title: Advanced thresholds
advanced.description: Sensible defaults - only change these if you know you want to.

add_lovelace_resource_manually.title: Add the Plant Monitor card as a dashboard resource
add_lovelace_resource_manually.description: Plant Monitor couldn't add its dashboard card automatically (this happens on YAML-mode dashboards). Add it once yourself: **Settings -> Dashboards -> ⋮ -> Resources -> Add resource**, URL `{url}`, resource type **JavaScript module**. You can then use the `plant-monitor-card` card on any dashboard.
